title: Lower Power: Hinge
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Tri-Planar Ankle × 8/side · Inchworm Walk × 4 · CL Dead Bug × 6/side · A-skip 2 × 20 yd
jumps: Trap Bar Deadlift 3 → Box Jump 5 → Trap Bar Jump 5 → Pogo Hops 10
Deadlift @ RPE 8 · jumps a little heavier (15–25%) · rest 3:00

cond.subtitle: Max effort, then walk it off
items: Assault bike or Treadmill Sprint: 15 sec all-out

note: Same deadlift weight is fine. Make the jumps faster and higher.
